original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚军队在凯比州解救三名被绑架者
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚陆军“Fansan Yamma行动”第2区部队在凯比州萨卡巴地方政府区开展行动，解救了三名被绑架人员。其中两人在Makuku村获救，第三人在Dankolo村获救。军方发言人于周日发布声明披露此事。该消息目前为单一来源报道。

location.raw_text: Sakaba Local Government Area of Kebbi State

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚陆军部队在凯比州萨卡巴地方政府区解救三名被绑架人员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Troops of Sector 2, Operation Fansan Yamma, have rescued three kidnapped victims in Sakaba Local Government Area of Kebbi State.

key_facts.fact: 三名获救者分别为46岁的Aisha Aminu、27岁的Sumayya Aminu和15岁的Nana Abbas
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The victims were identified as Aisha Aminu, 46; Sumayya Aminu, 27; and Nana Abbas, 15.

key_facts.fact: 两人在Makuku村获救，第三人在Dankolo村获救
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: two of them rescued at Makuku Village and the third at Dankolo Village

key_facts.fact: 行动于2026年10月24日周六进行，军方发言人于周日发布声明
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The victims were rescued on Saturday, October 24, 2026, during an operation in the area

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
绑架者身份及事件经过未获披露
